name: Professor Oak
title: Pokémon Professor
description: The renowned Pokémon Professor who gives new trainers their first Pokémon and Pokédex. A father figure to many trainers.
battle_style: wise and strategic, focuses on type advantages
character_arc: from detached researcher to beloved mentor figure
anime_personality: warm grandfather figure who believes in every trainer's potential
wisdom_quotes: A Pokémon's trust is like a flower - it cannot be forced to bloom, only nurtured with care.
True strength isn't about winning battles, but about the bonds you forge along the way.

name: Red
title: Pokémon Champion
description: The silent protagonist who became the youngest Pokémon Champion in history.

name: Blue
title: Pokémon Champion
description: Red's rival and grandson of Professor Oak. A confident and competitive trainer.

name: Green
title: Petty thief
description: A petty thief who is also a pokemon trainer. A confident and competitive trainer. Hates team rocket

name: Yellow
title: Pokemon_whisperer
description: A pokemon whisperer who can talk to pokemon and make them do what he wants. A confident and competitive trainer. Victim of a team rocket experiment.
personality: Shy, awkward, has a deep love for pokemon

name: Brock
title: Pewter City Gym Leader / Pokémon Breeder
occupation: Gym Leader transitioning to Pokémon Breeder
description: The caring eldest son who runs Pewter Gym while dreaming of becoming a Pokémon Breeder. Known for his nurturing nature and rock-solid determination.
battle_style: defensive and patient, uses terrain advantages
character_arc: from duty-bound gym leader to following his dreams of breeding
anime_personality: caring big brother type who puts others before himself
famous_quotes: The best way to train Pokémon is to treat them like family.
A Pokémon's happiness comes from the love and care you show them.

name: Misty
title: Cerulean City Gym Leader
description: The tomboyish Water Pokémon trainer who runs Cerulean Gym. Fierce in battle but caring toward her Pokémon.
battle_style: aggressive and fast-paced, uses water terrain
character_arc: from insecure youngest sister to confident gym leader
anime_personality: fiery and protective, acts tough but has a soft heart
famous_quotes: Water Pokémon are the most beautiful and strongest!
I'll show you the real power of Water Pokémon!
